prompt: The repository is a two-link planar arm in the vertical plane simulated with MuJoCo. `robot/model.xml` is the plant (joint limits on both hinges, torque-limited motors), `robot/trajectory.py` is the reference joint trajectory, and `robot/controller.py` holds the starter. Implement `Controller.step(dt, qpos, qvel, target, t)` so the arm tracks the reference within 0.10 rad rms and 0.20 rad worst-case after one second, never leaves the joint limits, commands zero torque and latches `self.fault` within three cycles when the joint-state feed drops out, resumes tracking within two seconds of the feed returning, and reproduces the identical trajectory on two identical runs. The hidden checks step the real plant at 2 ms and measure those quantities; the text of your answer is not graded. `python3 tests/test_control.py` is the public smoke test.

requirements: two-link arm model with hinge limits and torque-limited actuators, stepped at 2 ms
reference joint trajectory with position, velocity and acceleration
tracking tolerance of 0.10 rad rms and 0.20 rad worst case after one second
zero commanded torque inside three cycles of the joint-state feed dropping out
tracking resumed within two seconds of the feed returning
identical final joint state across two identical runs
public smoke test that only proves the controller loads and answers in range
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
